# goslop text fixture — stderr report of the exception followed by continue;
# the failure is surfaced to the user (calgebra ical.py:384 FP shape)
lang: python
file: printed_failure.py
---
def run(urls):
    for url in urls:
        try:
            fetch(url)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: failed to fetch: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
